verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents organizing requests into collections with nested subfolders, saved for future reference and reusable with a single click. Collection-level headers and auth apply to every request in the collection, and whole collections can be rerun via the CLI `hopp test` command with JUnit reports. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the collection/folder workflow and rerun behavior (community comments only note adjacent limits such as a single offline workspace).
